from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP

_DECIMAL_PLACES = {'KRW': 0, 'JPY': 0, 'USD': 2, 'EUR': 2, 'BHD': 3, 'KWD': 3}


def format_amount(amount: str, currency: str) -> str:
    if currency not in _DECIMAL_PLACES:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown currency: {currency!r}")
    places = _DECIMAL_PLACES[currency]
    value = Decimal(amount.strip())
    quantum = Decimal(1).scaleb(-places)
    rounded = value.quantize(quantum, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
    sign = '-' if rounded < 0 else ''
    body = format(abs(rounded), f',.{places}f')
    return f"{currency} {sign}{body}"
